baseline_ci: Parent reports four CI checks passed; this artifact does not treat CI as semantic-quality approval.
scope: Actual public development sources and the latest normal/condition pair. No synthetic reviews, extra model calls, market-frequency approval or alteration of completed outputs.
common_implementation_constraints: ResearchBundle.text/facts/source_id/URL/locator/document version remain immutable; source_facts stays the code-owned exact copy. Derived interpretations belong to a separate private evidence representation, never replace source facts.

Reuse the pinned StructuredModelClient, existing discover/plan calls, item-local validation and apply_field_patch. Do not add repeated instructions, an unconditional extra critic call or an automatic repair-budget reset.

Exact quotation/span/schema checks establish provenance, not natural-language entailment. Ambiguous actor, event order, cause, opinion or procedure applicability stays unresolved; do not claim code alone proves meaning.
Build narrow regression fixtures from the collected real sources. Contract/model-output stubs and deliberately corrupted candidate fields can test boundaries; do not manufacture customer reviews.

Keep the public PlanningBrief contract stable for the first implementation by projecting internal typed records into existing fields. Coordinate any future public evidence-view schema separately with PM/API/WEB.
